title: LASSO expression score distinguishes delayed kidney-graft function in retrospective cohorts
summary: A three-gene LASSO score was evaluated against observed delayed graft function after kidney transplantation. The study reports AUC 0.730 in an internal test split and 0.773 in a small separate biopsy cohort. This is retrospective clinical discrimination, without demonstrated prevention, treatment benefit or prospective deployment.
ai_technology: Ten-fold cross-validated LASSO for a three-gene delayed-graft-function score
organization: Capital Medical University; Beijing Chao-Yang Hospital

evidence.tested: From 202 post-reperfusion samples with graft-function information, the source made a 70:30 training/internal-test split. Training-set LASSO selected ANXA1, HSP90AA1 and NFKBIA. Reported AUC was 0.730 internally and 0.773 in GSE90861, a separate cohort of 23 paired-biopsy recipients, twelve with delayed and eleven with immediate graft function.
evidence.unknown: Small retrospective datasets and donor-type differences limit generalization. The separate cohort also informed earlier expression confirmation of candidate genes, so it is not a wholly untouched evaluation of the entire discovery workflow. Individual-patient split independence and supplementary implementation were not reconstructed. No causal necroptosis mechanism, reduced rejection, therapeutic benefit or locked prospective prediction was established by the represented model evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO learned nonzero expression features and coefficients for a combined score evaluated against measured clinical graft-function outcomes. Generic pathway enrichment and recovery of known inflammatory biology are not the represented finding.

source_review.scope: Read actual primary PMC cohort acquisition, gene-screening, LASSO training/internal split and external-evaluation Methods plus DGF Results through the web primary-text route. Publisher canonical front and fresh PubMed notice metadata checked. Graft-survival supplementary model and individual-patient reconstruction were not independently adjudicated. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
